title: Proper and open comparison on bounded origins
statement: Let O be a commutative ring and ell in O with all O/(ell^(n+1)) finite. Fix a compactification X --j--> Z --p--> Y of a morphism f, a strict etale compact-support package S, and its exceptional right adjunction G [def-sf-strict-etale-exceptional-adjoint-interfaces]. Fix actual site comparison packages CX,CY,CZ at S.PX,S.PY,S.PZ satisfying the bounded-origin equivalence clauses [def-pur-exceptional-system-transport-interfaces]. There exist an actual strict pro-etale compact-support package P and its proper/open comparison R [def-coef-system-site-transport-interfaces]. The comparison C_Y S -> P C_X is invertible on bounded-below etale systems. P preserves system origin and its finite operation preserves finite origin. The finite source-counit version of R is invertible on finite origin. For every n and finite origin N at Y, G_n(V_Y,n N) is bounded below. Evaluation of R followed by P's evaluation comparison and the image of CX's inverse-evaluation comparison equals CY's inverse-evaluation comparison followed by CY,n of S's evaluation comparison and then the finite R. This is an equality of actual derived morphisms, for every n and input, not merely equality on cohomology.

source.place: Zheng Construction 5.15 and Lemmas 4.10, 5.16 and 5.22; Stacks 0B65.

proof.text:
lift the open restriction and proper inverse image to ordinary strict
systems. Their levelwise section maps commute with restriction of scalars. The
left adjoint of open restriction is extension by zero, constructed by sheafifying
the direct sum of sections over open lifts; kernels and cokernels are termwise.
Exact localization gives its derived adjunction and representative factors.
Construct the inverse-image square on ordinary sections and localize it, with
its evaluation square retained. Take the proper mate and compose with the open
comparison. The finite proper mate is invertible for the quasi-compact,
quasi-separated proper factor on bounded-below inputs. Exact evaluation preserves
these bounds and detects isomorphisms, so the system map is invertible. The source
site counit identifies its origin version. This gives left stability on origins,
on systems and at each finite level. For the finite right bound, realize an arbitrary bounded-below finite input by a bounded-below system concentrated at that level, with every other level zero and zero transitions. Exact evaluation of the etale system bound, followed by G.evaluation, gives the finite bound; no flat singleton extension is needed. The direct site image preserves lower bounds. No absolute separatedness is used. Evaluating the actual
mate word gives the displayed comparison equation by the recorded unit/counit
identities and the open evaluation square.

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalProperOpenOriginComparison [∀ n : ℕ, Finite (O ⧸ (Ideal.span ({ell} : Set O)) ^ (n + 1))] (hX : ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence CX) (hY : ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence CY) (hZ : ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence CZ) : ∃ (P : ExceptionalProCompactSupport O ell c CX.proEvaluation CY.proEvaluation CZ.proEvaluation) (R : ExceptionalSystemCompactificationComparison S CX CY CZ P), (∀ M, (∃ a : ℤ, M.IsGE a) → IsIso ((exceptionalSystemComparison R).app M)) ∧ (∀ M, CX.origin M → CY.origin ((exceptionalProSupport P).obj M)) ∧ (∀ n M, CX.levelOrigin n M → CY.levelOrigin n ((P.val.levelDerivedOpen n ⋙ (P.val.properDerived.level n).direct).obj M)) ∧ (∀ n M, CX.levelOrigin n M → IsIso ((exceptionalSystemLevelOriginComparison R n).app M)) ∧ (∀ n N, CY.levelOrigin n N → ∃ a : ℤ, ((G.levelRight n).obj ((CY.image.level n).direct.obj N)).IsGE a) ∧ (∀ n M, (CY.proEvaluation.evaluation n).map ((exceptionalSystemComparison R).app M) ≫ (exceptionalProSupportEvaluation P n).hom.app (CX.image.system.inverse.obj M) ≫ (P.val.levelDerivedOpen n ⋙ (P.val.properDerived.level n).direct).map ((CX.image.inverseEvaluation n).hom.app M) = (CY.image.inverseEvaluation n).hom.app (S.functor.obj M) ≫ (CY.image.level n).inverse.map ((S.evaluation n).hom.app M) ≫ (exceptionalSystemLevelComparison R n).app ((S.PX.evaluation n).obj M))
